push.title: W 2-1 vs Flex musix | You: 8.8
push.body:
buddskees, an 8.8 against Flex musix. You're trending up like a hot-air balloon at the fair.

THE GOOD
+ 87% passing on 31 attempts, up from your usual 78%. You kept the ball moving like a good conversation.
+ Won 3 of 4 tackles (up from your usual 59%). You turned their best moments into our turnovers.
+ 1 key pass. That's the kind of vision you can't teach. Well, I can try, but you already have it.
+ Man of the Match, your 5th for us. Top performer, top teammate.
+ PhogsToffees owes you a milkshake for those passes.

THE BAD
- Shots on target 0, down from your usual 1. Let's call that a lesson and not a trend.
- Lowest key passes on the team: 1 (best was BellyTb1's 3). That needs to look different next time out.
- Tackles attempted: 4. Good, not great yet; top-quarter midfielders sit at 6+.
- Passes attempted 31, from 36 in your previous match. Try it this way: Move after you pass. A pass-and-move player is always an option.

Coach's drill: Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands.

Between you and me, buddskees: Every pro was once an amateur who didn't quit.

Today's lessons are tomorrow's strengths. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 2-1 vs Flex musix | You: 8.0
push.body:
An 8.0 from you, PhogsToffees. Steady hands, clear head. We'll build on that.

THE GOOD
+ 2 of 2 shots on target. You kept it low and on target. Keepers hate that.
+ 2 key passes. You're the opener on the team's toolbelt.
+ You and BellyTb1 had more chemistry than a high school lab.
+ Tackles attempted 7, up from your usual 4. That's a habit, and habits win leagues.
+ Better match rating than any of their humans (8.0 vs their best 7.6). That's the good stuff, like the corner piece of the brownie.

THE BAD
- Won 0 of 7 tackles (down from your usual 25%). Mind this: Every missed tackle leaves a runner free behind you. If you're not sure, contain and let cover arrive.
- Giveaways 14, up from your usual 9. That's the gap between a good night and a great one.
- Shots: 2. Middle of the road; 3+ is the fast lane.

Practice pointer: Win it with your body before your foot: shoulder to shoulder, then poke it away.

Before you go, PhogsToffees: The other team puts their shorts on one leg at a time too.

Tomorrow's a new chance. - Coach Lasso

push.body:
Solid shift, BellyTb1. A 7.7 clears the bar for a midfielder, and solid is the soil good things grow in.

THE GOOD
+ 3 key passes (up from your usual 1). Your passes had GPS and good manners.
+ A goal against Flex musix. Cool as the other side of the pillow.
+ You set it up, PhogsToffees knocked it down. Repeat as needed.
+ 7th straight match at 7.5 match rating. That's the bit I'll replay in my head on the drive home.
+ Missed tackles 0, down from your usual 2. I see you, and I like what I see.

THE BAD
- No tackles attempted (down from your usual 2). Here's the fix: Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into. That's how good becomes great.
- 1 goal from 4 on target. Here's what helps: Pick your spot before the ball arrives, then commit. Changing your mind mid-swing is how shots go wide. That's the whole secret.
- Lowest match rating on the team: 7.7 (best was buddskees's 8.8). We can fix that.
- Lowest assists on the team: 0 (best was buddskees's 1). That's where the match slipped.
- Lowest passes attempted on the team: 19 (best was buddskees's 31). That's the part of the tape we'll rewind.

Daily reps: Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball.

BellyTb1, take this with you: Heart wins the fifty-fifties.

Trust the work. - Coach Lasso
